create_multi_corpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusSampledDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with uniform sampling
create_custom_sampler: create a custom sampling function to replace the default uniform_sampler for dataset selection
collate_multi_corpus_batch: collate a mini-batch by sampling a dataset key and delegating to its collater function
map_index_to_dataset: map a global index to a dataset-specific index using modulo wrapping across underlying datasets
prefetch_multi_corpus_data: prefetch data across all underlying datasets by mapping indices and calling each dataset prefetch
